messages:
maria: Quick check — where can I find per-pool autoscaling graphs for `dedicated-prod-gpu-pool`? saw a saturation spike yesterday and want the 6h view.

aj: Grafana -> Dedicated Pools dashboard. direct link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/6b7X/dedicated-pools?orgId=1&var-pool=dedicated-prod-gpu-pool
Look at panels: Pool Utilization, Request Queue, Active Replicas over time.

samir: Prometheus queries I use:
```
avg_over_time(pool_utilization{pool="dedicated-prod-gpu-pool"}[5m])
sum(rate(request_queue_length{pool="dedicated-prod-gpu-pool"}[1m]))
max_over_time(active_replicas{pool="dedicated-prod-gpu-pool"}[10m])
```

ellen: Also check KV cache hit rate — when cache cold starts we see latency spikes.
Query:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total{pool="dedicated-prod-gpu-pool"}[5m]))
```

observability-bot: autoscaler event: scaled dedicated-prod-gpu-pool from 8 -> 16 replicas at 2025-11-05T13:22:11Z (reason: queue_length > 120 for 4m)

ryan: FYI alerts history: alert `PoolHighUtilization` fired twice yesterday at 13:15 and 13:20. Threshold currently 90%.

maria: Thinking we should tune to 80% and add a 3m for-duration to avoid flapping. Any objections?

aj: 80% seems reasonable for this pool (customer-facing low-latency). Also add refractory window 5m between alerts.

samir: fine but ensure we keep an experiment: lower to 80% in staging for 24h and check if autoscaler reacts appropriately.

ellen: I'll open a GH issue to track: include dashboards, screenshots, and alert edit. tagging @aj @samir

maria: thanks — please paste the dashboard snapshot in the issue. :thumbsup:

aj: quick tip: to get the 6h window use `from=now-6h&to=now` in the grafana link; and export panel JSON if you want to embed.

observability-bot: link to logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/stream?query=pool%3Ddedicated-prod-gpu-pool%20AND%20level%3DERROR

ryan: small note — we saw an unusual pattern: p95 latency > 2s for ~5min even after replicas scaled. looks like cold KV cache + model warmup.

maria: ok action items:
- ellen: create GH issue and attach screenshots + panel json
- samir: run staging test for 24h with 80% threshold
- aj: modify alert refractory window to 5m (after the test)

ellen: on it. will link the issue here when ready.

maria: thanks everyone.
